thread:
sre-bot: [ALERT] PROD inference-router - sustained high 5xx rate (>=1000/min) in us-west-2. Pager triggered to #eng-oncall and Pd escalation policy.

Aisha Patel: Acked. I'm on it — investigating error spikes and recent deploys.

Evan Morris: Thanks. Do we have a canary rollout or config push in the last 30m?

Ben Liu: Deploy history shows a config push to router scaling rules 22m ago (ben/configs#142). Could be related.

Carlos Gomez: Logs show a surge of backend model timeouts — downstream katana-embedder instances returning 504s.

Aisha Patel: Ok. First mitigation: enable degraded routing to cached-models shard, and scale up router pool by +3 pods. Doing now.

Aisha Patel: /run kubectl -n prod scale deployment inference-router --replicas=12

ops-bot: Command executed: scaled inference-router to 12 replicas.

Evan Morris: I'll add a temporary silence on the noisy alert for 30m to avoid page storms while we stabilize. Suggest silencing the "5xx_rate" alert but keep availability alerts active.

Aisha Patel: Silencing 5xx_rate for us-west-2 for 30m now.

sre-bot: Alert silence applied: rule=prod/inference-router/5xx_rate scope=us-west-2 duration=30m by Aisha Patel

Priya Shah: We should double-check client retries — increased concurrency + retries can amplify load. Any change to client backoffs?

Ben Liu: No client changes in last 24h. Looks isolated to katana instances. I'm restarting the embedder fleet in us-west-2 one AZ at a time.

Carlos Gomez: After scaling + routing, 5xx rate dropped to ~120/min. Still above baseline but much better.

Evan Morris: Good. We'll keep degraded routing for 20m and watch. Aisha, can you take a quick customer-impact snapshot for the incident report? i.e., which endpoints, error rates, and affected customers?

Aisha Patel: Brief: traffic to /v1/generate and /v1/chat saw elevated errors. Top affected teams: search-suggestions internal customer (10% of calls returned 5xx for ~14m). External customers: one high-volume partner saw degraded throughput (SLA risk). I'll paste metrics in post-incident doc.

sre-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> under observation. PagerDuty incident https://pd.example/INC12345 assigned to eng-oncall.

Evan Morris: We're going to transition to handoff in 30 min. If stable, close Pd incident and create post-incident ticket for tuning.

Carlos Gomez: Noted — I'll follow up on embedder fleet health.

Priya Shah: For follow-ups: we need (1) alert tuning to reduce noise and avoid paging for transient spikes, (2) a dashboard that shows degraded routing fraction vs 5xx, (3) update severity policy mapping (page vs ticket) to clarify paging thresholds for inference errors.

Aisha Patel: Agreed. Quick proposals now:
- change 5xx_rate alert to require >=3 minutes sustained and >5 hosts contributing, instead of current 1m/any host spike.
- add dedup rule so identical 5xx alerts across AZs aggregate into single page.
- create "Inference Health" Grafana dashboard (pct successful requests, median latency, cache-hit-ratio, degraded-routing%) with 1m resolution.

Ben Liu: Also propose: page only for availability/throughput P1 (global loss or >=25% error rate), for smaller localized spikes create P2 ticket in #eng-sre with auto-assignment. Pages should go to on-call only if it's an automated Pd trigger; manual escalations OK.

Evan Morris: I like that. Let's be concrete: in PagerDuty map alerts to severities:
```
- P1 (page): availability_loss_global OR error_rate >=25% across region for >=5m
- P2 (ticket): error_rate between 5%-25% sustained >=3m OR latency increase >2x baseline
- P3 (ticket): transient spikes <3m or single host issues
```

Priya Shah: Also add a rule: if an alert silenced by on-call, still create a low-priority ticket to track and ensure we don't miss recurring noise.

Aisha Patel: I'll open the post-incident ticket with action items and owners. Quick runbook edits: update the inference-router runbook with the degraded routing play and the new embedder restart procedure.

Evan Morris: I'll follow up on PagerDuty mapping and escalation rules. Ben — can you schedule a Grafana dashboard template and add the new panels?

Ben Liu: Yep, I'll prototype a dashboard and send link to #eng-oncall for review.

Carlos Gomez: For alert rule changes, I'll push a PR to ops/monitoring-alerts: change 5xx rule to 3m sustain + min_hosts:5 and add dedup. Will request review from Priya and Evan.

Aisha Patel: Action items summary: 
- Aisha: Post-incident note + customer impact (INC12345).
- Carlos: PR for alert tuning (ops/monitoring-alerts).
- Ben: New Grafana "Inference Health" dashboard prototype.
- Evan: Update PagerDuty mappings + escalation doc.
- Priya: Add follow-up ticket to ensure runbook updates and postmortem.

Priya Shah: I'll create the follow-up ticket now and assign owners. Ticket: INF-1480 "Reduce alert noise & update severity routing after 5xx incident".

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-1480 and assigned to Aisha Patel, Carlos Gomez, Ben Liu, Evan Morris.

Aisha Patel: Thanks all. Leaving monitoring on for 1h; will handoff to Evan at 17:30. If everything stays green, we'll close Pd incident and mark mitigated.

Evan Morris: Acknowledged. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Incident INC12345 status changed: resolved by Aisha Patel -> description: degraded routing + scale + embedder restarts mitigated 5xx spikes. Postmortem ticket INF-1480 created.

Aisha Patel: I'll draft a short postmortem and share in #postmortems tomorrow morning with suggested alert config diffs.

Ben Liu: One more ask: let's add a small synthetic canary for embedder latency that fails open on >200ms p50 to catch regressions earlier. I'll add to ops/synthetics.

Carlos Gomez: Good call. Adding that to INF-1480 as a separate subtask.

Evan Morris: Closing thread for now, follow-ups in INF-1480.

sre-bot: Thread archived.
